name: BulkCertPDF
summary: Turns an Excel or CSV attendee list into named PDF certificates, with 8 designs, your logo and signatures.
best_for: training providers, course organisers and HR teams who need named PDF certificates from a spreadsheet without designing each one
skip_if: you need certificates linked to a learning platform, you want to keep attendee data off third-party tools, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The free plan adds a watermark and stops at 25 certificates a month, and the Batch Pass expires after 7 days. We did not check how the hosted verification pages handle personal data.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-11 on bulkcertpdf.com/pricing, US dollars) BulkCertPDF has a Free plan, a one-off Batch Pass and a Pro subscription. Free costs $0, takes an Excel or CSV upload, includes all 8 designs, your logo and signatures, and covers 25 certificates a month with a watermark. The Batch Pass costs $19 once and covers up to 500 certificates without a watermark; it gives 7 days of access and is not a subscription. Pro costs $29 a month or $199 a year, shown as $16.58 a month and a 43% saving, and allows unlimited certificates and batches without a watermark; the page says you can cancel any time. The page shows a 14-day money-back guarantee and secure checkout by Lemon Squeezy, and says taxes are calculated at checkout where they apply.

schema_offer.description: Pro monthly, Pro is $29 a month or $199 a year (shown as $16.58 a month); Batch Pass is $19 once for up to 500 certificates and 7 days of access; Free is $0 for 25 certificates a month. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-11.

compare_with.name: Certifier
compare_with.why: Certifier is a certificate platform with an account and automation, while BulkCertPDF turns one spreadsheet into one ZIP. Run the same 25-name list through each free plan and compare the time and the look of the result
